features: Adjusts from 18 in. to 30 in. to fit your unique closet design
Can be mounted with or without a cleat

description: The Closet Pro HD 18 in. - 30 in. Adjustable Closet Rod with fixed flange creates hanging space in a uniquely sized closet. The expandable length allows for an easy installation with or without cleats. The rod is made out of 22 gauge steel with a 1-inch diameter. Features a platinum finish. Hardware included.
